_comment: Where verify.yml runs its Windows sections (tools/ci/runner-router.cjs). Owner decisions 2026-09-23: every verify job runs on Blacksmith ('anything that's queued and not actually running, send to blacksmith'; 'a Blacksmith run produces a main check'), and idle qualified self-hosted Windows hosts (EDGE-RUNN-ENVY and any other host carrying ai-devops-windows-qualified) are used as extra capacity ('why are we saving ENVY? WE NEED TO SPEED THINGS UP!!!'). A section goes to a qualified host only when one is online and idle at routing time; otherwise it runs on Blacksmith. GitHub-hosted runners are never a routing target.
